Definition: from a compound of G5525 and G71; to be a dance-leader, i.e. (generally) to furnish:--give, minister.
BiblicalUsage: Choregeo is to supply, to furnish what is needed, and Paul and Peter both use it of God's giving. Peter says if any man ministers, let him do it as of the ability which God supplies, and Paul says He that ministers seed to the sower will multiply the seed sown.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God supplies both the seed and the strength to sow it, and my giving is only the passing on of His gift.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
